_comment: Prices per million tokens, by model id (a client id like openai:gpt-4o-mini works too, and a trailing * matches a prefix). Every row of a run is priced from this table when it runs (cost.usd on the row, with the table's asOf), so a run keeps the price of its day. Check these against the provider's price list before trusting a number: they change, and the bench cannot verify them. Local serving is priced at 0 — electricity and hardware are not counted. Add the models you run; a model with no entry runs unpriced and the cost view says so.

local:*.note: served locally; electricity and hardware are not counted

vllm:*.note: served locally; electricity and hardware are not counted

mlx:*.note: served locally; electricity and hardware are not counted
